BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1.       Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map Noi 1 -I in an area

bound by



The public alley next south of and parallel to West Huron Street; North Talman

Avenue; a line 124 feet south of and parallel to West Huron Sti-eet; And the public alley

next west of and parallel to North Talman Avenue



to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townliouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. Tliis ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

 10.    Lot size in square feet (or dimensions?)      100' x 24'

 11.    Current Use of the property 2-storv, 2 dwelling unit residential building and detached 2-
        car garage.

12.    Reason for rezoning the subject property; The applicant wishes to rezone the subject
       property to allow sufficient density to bring the 2 existing residential units in the existing
       2-storv residential building into compliance. The applicant plans an interior renovation of
       the 2 dwelling units and renovation of the front facade; the footprint of the exiting
       building will remain the same after all planned work is completed. The existing 2-car
       garage will remain with no changes.

13.    Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
       dwelling units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
       space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
       The applicant wishes to rezone tiie subject property to allow sufficient density to bring
       the 2 existing residential units in the existing 2-storv residential building, approximately
       26' in height, into compliance. The applicant plans an interior renovation of the 2
       dwelling units and renovation of the front fa9ade; the footprint of the exiting building will
       remain the same after all planned work is completed. The existing 2-car garage will
       remain with no changes. There are no planned commercial units at the property.

14.    The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
       and/or afinancialcontribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
       receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowablefloorarea,
       or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
       sheet or visit wvvw.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more infonnation). Is this project subject to
       the ARO?
